_comment: Hand-curated word -> ARASAAC pictogram id. Checked BEFORE the API and beats it by design. Populate from real use, when a wrong symbol actually shows up. Keys are lowercased and keep their accents. Fixing a wrong symbol is ALWAYS an entry here, never a ranking heuristic.
_comment_extranar: 36909 is labelled 'echar de menos, añorar' in ARASAAC's Spanish, so bestsearch/extrañar 404s: the Latin American synonym is simply not in their keyword list. Same pictogram, different word. The English label on 36909 is 'miss'.
_comment_exported: Pinned on the device by the adult, exported 2026-08-25, verified live before landing here.
_comment_viene: A conjugation gap, not a wrong symbol: bestsearch/viene 404s because ARASAAC does not conjugate, so the child saw a placeholder. Deliberately NOT added to lemmas.es.json as viene -> venir, which would send resolve() looking for 'venir' and leave this override orphaned.
_comment_export_2: Exported 2026-09-16, verified live before landing here.
_comment_extranar_2: This export also re-pinned extrañar -> 39426 on the device, the same id already rejected for English 'miss' above. Not taken here for the same reason: 39426 is a different drawing of the same affective sense, and the point of pinning extrañar -> 36909 was one symbol for one meaning in both languages. The device will keep showing 39426 until that pin is undone in the adult panel; do not re-import it from a future export either.
_comment_letters: Below: letter-card vocabulary (src/aac/data/letters/) where bestsearch and search both miss or land on the wrong meaning, verified live. A synonym or related concept, never a ranking change.
